dct_creator_sm: Fairweather, Aaron D. (School of Environmental Sciences. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4026-8461
dct_description_sm: Datasets related to the creation of a novel, cheap, replicable, and field relevant ecotoxicological laboratory method for testing non-target soil insects. Lasius neoniger is agriculturally wide-spread, and easy to rear under laboratory conditions. Soil applications of imidacloprid at below 0.1% of recommended field rates are lethal to a common non-target ant species. Imidacloprid significantly impacted ant grooming, decreasing chance of survival.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data and R code for: A novel method for testing the impacts of pesticide exposure on soil-nesting insects: A case study using the ant Lasius neoniger and the neonicotinoid insecticide Imidacloprid
